_comment: SALES DEMO / PREVIEW. Summit Ridge Roofing is a FICTIONAL DFW roofing prospect. This config drives a preview dashboard that mirrors what a real Wing client (Hero's, Jackson) receives, so a prospect on a Zoom pitch can see the exact deliverable. There is no git repo and no live site: content comes from a hand-authored demo state file (summit-ridge-roofing.state.json) and every URL is illustrative. The brand subhead states plainly that this is a sample so no one mistakes it for delivered work.

brand.name: Summit Ridge Roofing
brand.headline: What your Summit Ridge Roofing dashboard would look like
brand.subhead: This is a SAMPLE preview built with example content to show the exact dashboard a Summit Ridge account would get. The pages, posts and figures below are illustrative demo data, not work delivered on a live site.

_theme_comment: Roofing-appropriate palette: deep slate-blue brand tile (#24344d) with a warm amber accent for pop. Distinct from Hero's navy/red. Dark mode uses a lifted amber so it stays legible on the dark ground; light mode drops to a deeper amber for contrast on white.

_types_comment: Drawn from the slate-blue / amber / evergreen roofing palette rather than a generic chart set. Each hue means the same thing in the chart, the mix bar and the list.
_outreach_comment: PREVIEW: shows the outreach lanes a roofing client can turn on. Nothing is actually sending -- states make clear what is live vs. what needs access, exactly as a real dashboard would on day one.

outreach.intro: Sample view of the outreach and social lanes a Summit Ridge account can switch on. In this preview nothing is sending yet -- each card shows what it would take to go live.
